incident.title: TinyTask Multi-Tenant Authorization Bypass (IDOR)
incident.scenario: An authenticated member in Workspace A manipulates the URL parameter `/api/v1/workspaces/ws_987/members` with the ID of Workspace B (`ws_123`) to modify access control lists and elevate user privileges across tenant boundaries.
incident.target_asset: Workspace Member Access Control List & Role Bindings
incident.actor: Authenticated user with standard 'Viewer' role in Workspace A
